headline.zh-CN: 专辑完成状态、范围筛选与灵活评审
headline.en: Album completion, scope filters and flexible reviews

summary.zh-CN: 有效曲目全部完成后，专辑自动进入已完成列表，不再显示逾期或进入需要关注。 按参与关系筛选专辑，在曲目详情调整进度，并为单曲管理灵活评审名单。
summary.en: Albums move to Completed when all eligible tracks finish, without overdue alerts or attention reminders. Filter albums by participation, adjust progress from track details, and manage flexible review rosters per track.

description.zh-CN: 排除已拒绝和已归档曲目后，至少一首有效曲目且全部完成，专辑自动标记为已完成。新增曲目或退回制作后恢复进行中；完成不会触发归档或清理文件。
description.en: An album completes when it has at least one eligible track and all eligible tracks are completed. Rejected and archived tracks are excluded. Adding a track or returning one to production reopens the album; completion never archives or deletes files.

title.zh-CN: 分开查看进行中与已完成专辑

description.zh-CN: 专辑管理新增已完成标签页。已完成专辑停止截止日期提醒并退出需要关注，历史问题以中性样式保留，仪表盘置顶与导出入口继续可用。
description.en: Album management now has In Progress, Completed, and Archived tabs. Completed albums leave Needs Attention and stop deadline reminders; historical issues remain neutral, and dashboard pinning and export stay available.

description.zh-CN: 新增全部、我主催、我参与筛选，按账号记住选择。
description.en: Choose all, managed, or participating albums; your selection is remembered per account.

description.zh-CN: 具有权限的管理者可在曲目流程区域直接调整进度。
description.en: Authorized managers can adjust progress directly from the track workflow area.

description.zh-CN: 可为单曲阶段启用灵活评审，增减名单并保留历史；全员完成后自动通过或退回修改，保存前可预览流向。
description.en: Enable flexible review for a track stage, edit its roster while retaining history, and preview automatic pass or revision outcomes before saving.
